name: Compact instructions
summary: Tells compaction what to keep verbatim: constraints and prohibitions, file paths, commands, identifiers and error text, plus the goal, decisions, changed files, failing tests and next steps.

evidence.setting: one compaction recall test; the gain came from verbatim text
evidence.effect: better recall of seeded constraints after compaction (not paired on this wording)

killTest.hypothesis: Compact instructions keep seeded constraints through compaction
killTest.pass: At least 10 points more seeded constraints still followed after compaction, cost not higher
killTest.budget: 10 long tasks that compact x 2 arms x 2 runs
killTest.scheduled: v8.0 maintainer reference bench, first run after release
